title: linear fetch_projects
description: One record per Linear project. The payload is the connector's ProjectNode re-encoded, so every key is always present and nothing else is.

description.description: Project description. Empty string when unset.

state.description: Project state as Linear reports it: backlog, planned, started, paused, completed or canceled.

url.description: Project URL in the Linear app. Empty string when unset.

progress.description: Completion from 0 to 1, computed by Linear.

targetDate.description: Target date as YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string when unset.

createdAt.description: When the project was created. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

updatedAt.description: When the project last changed. Also the DataDate. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

archivedAt.description: When the entity was archived, or null.
